name: Silent Hill 2 (2024)
native_kbm_note: No native keyboard/mouse gameplay support on PS5; not listed among PS5 KBM-supported games (wepc.com list) and official controls are controller-only (source: https://www.wepc.com/gaming/what-ps5-games-support-keyboard-and-mouse/)
notes: Prima lists both PC and PlayStation; game8 cross-checks the PS5 buttons. Next/previous ranged weapon (mouse wheel) has no listed PS5 button, so it is not mapped. Back in gameplay (RMB/Circle) clashes with aim on PC, so it is not mapped. The investigation zoom (MMB) uses L2, the same button as aim. Struggle uses LMB on PC and Cross on PS5; it is not mapped and the LMB->R2 mapping covers attack. Inventory is also Tab on PC. V: tap = quick heal, hold = syringe.
